official.description_text:
Postdoc in process efficiency for nitrocellulose
Login and apply
KTH Royal Institute of Technology, School of Engineering Sciences in Chemistry, Biotechnology and Health
Job description
Would you like to make nitrocellulose production more resource-efficient and sustainable? We are looking for a postdoc at the competence centre Svenskt Krut at KTH, where academia, government agencies and industry jointly strengthen Sweden's capability in nitrocellulose (NC).
I projektet analyserar vi nitreringsprocessen och delprocesserna för att återvinna och återanvända syror, tvättvatten och lösningsmedel
In the project we analyse the nitration process and sub-processes for rthe ecovery and reuse of acids, washing water and solvents. Your role is to map and quantify process and residual streams, establish mass balances and evaluate recovery techniques such as distillation, membrane processes and sorption.
You will carry out laboratory and smaller pilot trials on the most promising solutions, perform a techno-economic analysis and propose a greener NC process. Flow simulation and AI-supported data analysis are central tools. The work is carried out at the Department of Fibre and Polymer Technology and in collaboration with FOI and industrial partners.
Qualifications
Requirements
A doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign degree. This eligibility requirement must be met no later than the time the employment decision is made.
Documented scientific expertise in chemical engineering, process engineering or a closely related field, demonstrated through publications.
Experience of mass balances, flow simulation or separation and recovery techniques (e.g. distillation, membranes or sorption).
Very good command of English, spoken and written, as it is required in the daily work.
As a person you are independent, take initiative and have a strong ability to collaborate in an interdisciplinary environment.
Swedish citizenship.
Preferred qualifications
A doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign degree, obtained within the last three years prior to the application deadline
Experience of techno-economic analysis or sustainability assessment of processes.
Experience of AI- or data-driven process analysis.
Experience of working in an industry-related process environment, preferably with acids or residual streams.
Teaching abilities.
Awareness of diversity and equal opportunity issues, with specific focus on gender equality.
Great emphasis will be placed on personal skills.
Join us at KTH
KTH shapes the future through education, research and innovation. As a leading international technical university, we play an active role in advancing the transition towards a sustainable society. At KTH, you have the opportunity to grow and develop in a creative and dynamic environment, with good working conditions and attractive benefits. Equality, diversity and equal opportunities are essential to quality and form an integral part of KTH’s core values as a university and public authority.
Learn more about our benefits and what it's like to work and grow at KTH.

To apply for the position
Log into KTH's recruitment system to apply for this position. You are responsible for ensuring that your application is complete according to the instructions in the ad.
The application must include:
CV including relevant professional experience and knowledge.
Copy of diplomas and grades from your previous university studies. Translations into English or Swedish if the original documents have not been issued in any of these languages.
Brief account of why you want to conduct research, your academic interests and how they relate to your previous studies and future goals. Maximally two pages long.
Your complete application must be received at KTH no later than the last day of application, midnight CET/CEST (Central European Time/Central European Summer Time).
About the employment
The position offered is for, at the most, two years.

ai.summary: Postdoc in process analysis and optimisation for nitrocellulose production, focusing on mapping process and residual streams, establishing mass balances, and evaluating recovery and recycling techniques (distillation, membranes, sorption). Role includes laboratory and pilot trials, techno-economic analysis, flow simulation, and AI-supported data analysis in collaboration with FOI and industry.

thematic_fit.rationale: Chemical engineering, process optimisation, and sustainability assessment of industrial nitration. No overlap with human-centred XR, spatial learning, collaborative immersive systems, or user-centred design. The researcher's domains focus on human interaction and spatial cognition; this role is pure process engineering and sustainability in defence-industrial chemistry.

methodological_fit.rationale: Both involve systematic analysis and data-driven decision-making. The position emphasises mass-balance methodology, flow simulation, and AI-supported data analysis—abstractions that overlap with structured experimental methodology. However, the technical context is entirely different: the researcher uses qualitative/quantitative user-study methods and spatial-performance measurement; this role requires chemical engineering, process simulation, and techno-economic modelling. No transferable practical skills.

growth_value.rationale: Developing expertise in process engineering, mass-balance analysis, and techno-economic assessment does not address the researcher's stated capability gaps (spatial cognition measurement, immersive-system design, collaborative learning evaluation). Introduction to flow simulation and AI-supported analysis has limited relevance to human-centred research methodology. Does not advance target identity.

strategic_value.rationale: KTH is a strong institution and the Svenskt Krut competence centre has credibility in its domain. However, the collaboration with FOI (Swedish Defence Research Agency) and industrial partners in nitrocellulose production is orthogonal to HCI and immersive systems research. Does not align with target institutions (Aalto, TU Delft) or communities focused on human-centred design. No positioning for doctoral research in target area.

eligibility_flags: Requires completed PhD by employment start; researcher has MSc in progress (thesis stage).
Swedish citizenship stated as mandatory requirement ('Krav'). Researcher profile does not specify citizenship.
Requires demonstrated expertise in chemical engineering, process engineering, or closely related field; researcher background is in HCI and XR, not chemical engineering.
risks: Does not meet doctoral degree requirement at application time.
No background in chemical engineering, process design, mass-balance methodology, separation technologies, or flow simulation; requires substantial domain retraining.
Significant expertise gap in techno-economic analysis and industrial process optimisation.
Defence-industrial context (FOI, nitrocellulose for Swedish defence) may introduce security constraints.
Moves researcher away from human-centred systems and toward industrial chemistry, misaligned with target identity and institutions.
